info.name: user-template API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the API, in the same structure as the routes.

**Setup** (see postman/README.md in the repo):
1. Postman Vault > settings: enable **support in Postman scripts**, and allow this collection.
2. Add a vault secret `loginPassword`, and set the `loginEmail` collection variable.
3. Run **Auth > Login**. The session token is stored in the vault as `authToken`.

Authed requests inherit the collection's Bearer auth (`{{vault:authToken}}`). Public ones are set to No Auth. The token is refreshed automatically when it's past half its life, so it only needs a new login after 2 hours idle.

Requests that come from an email link use the `linkToken` variable: paste the last part of the link into it.

item.description: Needs an ADMIN or SUPERUSER account. Requests on a user use the `targetUserId` variable, which **List users** fills in. Nobody can act on themselves, admins only on regular users, and superusers can't be targeted.
